bull_points.claim: The business is FCF-positive at $517.1M LTM, making it self-funding with no runway constraint despite the leverage.

bull_points.claim: Absolute revenue has risen every year from 5,587 (FY21) to 9,954 LTM, with revenue YoY +4.1% latest same-quarter — the top line is growing, not eroding.

bull_points.claim: Management is buying back stock, reducing share count -6.6% over trailing ~1.8 years (65.3M to 61.0M), a capital-return posture inconsistent with a survival crisis.

On the discount-to-peers question: the name trades at TEV/EBITDA 4.1x vs a heterogeneous peer median of 5.3x — but the human must judge whether that gap is EARNED (name's EBITDA margin 12% vs peer-median 17%, EBITDA growth -4% vs 0%, Debt/EBITDA 3.4 vs 2.0) or RESIDUAL/overshoot, since the fundamental deltas point to several worse metrics.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: EBITDA margin has compressed from 16% (FY22) to 12% LTM, but the paired reconciler shows absolute EBITDA also fell from a 1,295 peak (FY24) to 1,231 LTM — so this is a GENUINE signal, not merely an optical %-decline: both the ratio AND the absolute dollar figure are declining off the peak.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: Net-debt/EBITDA is 4.4x and net-debt/OCF is 7.6x with interest coverage of only 3.4x — a heavily levered balance sheet against a declining EBITDA base.

bear_points.claim: ROIC has structurally deteriorated from 9.0% (FY22) to 3.9% LTM despite the revenue build — capital is generating progressively less return, signalling the growth is being bought, not earned.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: The name has fallen -42.6% over 180 days while the IWM benchmark rose +18.0%, a -59.7% relative underperformance — the de-rating is sharply idiosyncratic, not a market-wide move.

The discount to peers is at least partly EARNED: the name's EBITDA margin (12%) trails the peer median (17%) and its EBITDA growth (-4%) trails the peer median (0%) with higher leverage (3.4 vs 2.0) — fundamental deltas consistent with a value trap rather than a clean overshoot.

decisive_question.question: Is the AI/iX-Suite shift a genuine margin-accretive growth engine that reverses the EBITDA and ROIC decline, or is it cover for a CX/BPO model whose human-agent revenue base is structurally eroding while leverage stays high?

evidence_for.claim: Management states Technology wins are up >61% YoY, signed annual contract value for AI solutions more than doubled QoQ, and >40% of new business now includes their own technology, with exited-2025 AI revenue of over $60M reaching breakeven.

evidence_for.claim: Absolute revenue continues to rise (9,954 LTM vs 9,826 FY25) and the name remains FCF-positive at $517.1M, giving room to fund the transition without external capital.

evidence_against.claim: Despite the revenue build, both EBITDA margin (16%→12%) and absolute EBITDA (1,295→1,231) are off their peaks and ROIC has fallen to 3.9%, so the 'accretive-at-scale' transition has not yet shown up in the consolidated numbers.
